explanation: Miller's fundamental floor is ~1 fJ/bit; today's systems sit at 500-1500 fJ/bit, the gap driven mainly by laser efficiency and ring thermal control. ~1 pJ/bit is the electrical-wire figure, ~1 aJ is the single-photon energy alone (before receiver and component overheads), and ~1 nJ is far too large.
